caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Average Speech Recognition (ASR) score for different trigger words across various conditions. The x-axis represents trigger words, labeled alphabetically from ‘bb’ to ‘stunning’, and is scaled linearly from a value of approximately 0.1 to 0.9. The y-axis represents the ASR score, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.9, and is also scaled linearly. A solid orange line, marked with orange ‘x’ markers, depicts the ASR score for the ‘start’ trigger word, beginning at approximately 0.2 and declining to a minimum value of approximately 0.35 at the lower x-value. A solid red line, marked with red ‘x’ markers, shows the ASR score for the ‘random’ trigger word, starting at approximately 0.1 and rising to approximately 0.75 at the upper x-value. Finally, a solid blue line, marked with blue circles, demonstrates the ASR score for the ‘end’ trigger word starting at around 0.4 and decreasing to a minimum of approximately 0.6 at the lower x-value.
